@graph.name: Banana Republic, Rebrand Concept
@graph.description: An independent, speculative rebrand concept for the clothing retailer Banana Republic. The wordmark is wayward: every letter leaves the line, and the one R in the name is cut. Includes a re-architected homepage. Not affiliated with Banana Republic or Gap Inc.

@graph.name: Universe API
@graph.description: A foundational macro-systems design framework grounded in first-principles engineering and sovereign logic.
@graph.abstract: The operating philosophy centers on re-architecting digital infrastructure from the mulch up: replacing synthetic friction with closed-loop systems, asset-based leverage, and forms of growth that emerge organically rather than through extractive mechanisms.
@graph.disambiguatingDescription: Engineering makes the spirit legible. Spirit makes the engineering worth holding.
keywords: Infrastructure designed to compound rather than extract
